summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the motor_038 contract. The governance-stage wrapper delegates directly to the runtime adapter, emits a structured dominant-variable register with explicit evidence-state promotion, preserves archetipal and conditional distinctions, and injects owner_control_boundary when upstream hypotheses do not provide it.

findings: The implementation accepts the declared upstream inputs from target definition, system abstraction, dominant variable hypotheses, asset-field evidence and dataset coverage, with the wrapper enforcing mapping-shaped input before delegation.
The adapter emits the expected outputs: dominant_variable_register, dominant_variable_count and observed_or_conditional_variable_count.

Executable coverage confirms the documented building and manufacturing behaviors, including observed LL97 pathway handling for NYC buildings and conditional manufacturing variables such as throughput, thermal duty, compressed air and downtime.
The implementation stays within boundary: it does not emit peers, correlations, fairness or strategy; it only normalizes the dominant-variable layer for downstream motors.
Each dominant-variable row carries the governed fields variable, layer, dominance, evidence_state, why_it_could_matter, what_confirms_it, what_falsifies_it and decision_impact.
The count surfaces remain synchronized with the emitted register and distinguish total rows from rows already promoted beyond archetypal-prior state.

The read-only governance-wrapper smoke check for One Vanderbilt produced five variables with four observed-or-conditional rows, including LL97_pathway as OBSERVED_FACT and owner_control_boundary as CONDITIONAL_HYPOTHESIS.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Executable conformance evidence covered the direct building and manufacturing dominant-variable paths in the structural-intelligence system lane. This is sufficient for conformance review because it exercises the key promotion rules and register shape described in test_spec.md and failure_modes_spec.md.
test_results.notes: Ran pytest -q on runtime-orchestrator/tests/test_structural_intelligence_system_lane.py -k motor_038 with 2 passing tests. Also executed a read-only smoke invocation through artifacts/implementation/codebase/engine.py using a One Vanderbilt case and confirmed the wrapper returns the runtime adapter surface without local logic drift.
